title: Circuit-value validation
statement: For every bit string $z$, membership in the circuit-value language is equivalent to the specified circuit-code evaluator returning true on $z$. The language consists of pair encodings of a circuit code and an input string such that the code describes a well-formed circuit with fan-in at most two, the input length equals the circuit's number of input variables, and the circuit accepts that input.
caveat: The statement equates the language with a particular abstract evaluator; its detailed transition rules are lengthy and are not fully captured by the supplied informal descriptions.
